working_definition: Cells of the authors' cellularisation cluster(s) (Ing-Simmons et al. 2021, Fig. 2; markers bnk, slam), control embryos at 2.5-3.5 h after egg laying.

best_match.fbbt_definition: A(n) somatic cell that is part of a(n) stage 5 embryo.

justification: The authors: "Two clusters express cellularization stage genes (bnk, slam) and represent cells from embryos in the earlier stages of cellularization due to the timed collection": somatic cells of the stage 5 embryo (the clusters' stage, embryonic stage 5, from their own expression).
recommendation: Map to FBbt:00059313 somatic cell of stage 5 embryo (exact match).
